text:
Alex: Heads up — I'm starting onboarding for llama2-fp8. Pushed weights to s3://redwood-models/llama2-fp8/v1/ (sha256 ok).
Priya: Nice. Where did you put the tokenizer?
Alex: tokenizer.json and merges.bpe in the same bucket under /tokenizer/. Note: vocab contains a few non-UTF8 bytes (0x96) from Windows hyphen — saw this break a downstream tokenizer earlier.
Rachel: yep that char bites. We run sanitize_tokenizer.sh in CI for these. Can someone add it to the new model workflow?
Jamie: On runtime side, I'm preparing a container build to test inference. Default base uses CUDA 12.1 + Triton 2.20. Any kernel preferences?
Alex: model_config.yaml suggests prefer_fused_attention: true and kernels: ["flash_attn_cuda", "triton_scaled_attn"]. FlashAttn historically needs CUDA 11.8 build unless we apply the compatibility patch.
Priya: FYI CI just failed on an unrelated model with libcuda version mismatch — suspect the image uses system CUDA != toolkit in build.
ci-bot: CI: build #5827 failed at gpu-image step — log excerpt: "NVRM: API mismatch: the client has the wrong version"
Jamie: I'll try rebuilding container with ARG CUDA_VER=11.8 and TRITON_VER=2.15 to get flash_attn compiled cleanly.
Alex: Would prefer we keep CUDA12 in prod if possible. Can we fall back to Triton-only kernels to avoid rebuilding base images?
Priya: Yes but expect ~25-35% perf delta on long sequences based on last perf run. Might be acceptable for a canary.
Rachel: For canary, we should set a config override: kernels: ["triton_scaled_attn"], max_batch_size: 8, fallback_model: "llama2-quant". Add KV-cache warmup in rollout.
Jamie: Will open PR for runtime changes and a separate PR for container. Ping @Alex for review when done.
Alex: Also add a quick validator step in model_onboard CI that loads the tokenizer and tokenizes a sample prompt to catch the 0x96 issue early.
Priya: Quick snippet I added to the onboarding job:
```
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
tok = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
print(tok.encode('— sample prompt').tokens)
```
This will error fast if the tokenizer file has encoding issues.
Rachel: Also update weights metadata: meta.json -> preferred_cuda = "12.1" only if flash_attn binary is built against 12.1. Otherwise set preferred_cuda = "11.8" and kernels = ["triton_scaled_attn"].
ops-bot: (note) please ensure model weight s3 ACL allows read for onboarding-ci role.
Jamie: CI gave the same API mismatch locally; I'm going to try two builds in parallel: (1) rebuild base with CUDA11.8 + flash_attn, (2) runtime-only change to force triton kernels.
deploy-bot: Canary queue created for cluster dedicated-eu (policy: 10% RPS, rollback on 5% error increase).
Jamie: Created PR 4321 with runtime override and PR 4322 for docker rebuild. @Alex @Priya please review.
Alex: Left a couple inline comments on 4321 (small config nit). :eyes:
Priya: LGTM pending green CI on the tokenizer check.
Jamie: Merging PR 4321 after CI passes, starting container rebuild (CUDA=11.8) now — ETA ~45m. I'll post updates here.
Alex: Thanks. If tokenizer errors persist after sanitize step, I'll run a quick fix to replace 0x96 with ASCII hyphen and re-upload.
Rachel: I'll add a short runbook note in /docs/onboarding for this exact UTF8-vocab problem.
Alex: Great. Will follow up if we hit more kernel surprises. :thumbsup:
